categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes PSBT handling and constructor in wallet-facing GUI dialogs (send and fee-bumping) to configure PSBT version generation.
categories.rationale: Prevents interoperability failures with hardware wallets and external tools that do not support PSBTv2 when exporting PSBTs from the GUI. The description cites issue #36518, noting that external tools frequently fail because 'the GUI can't do anything interesting with PSBTv2 yet'.
